stale: The file changed outside the form. The form reread it: repeat the edit.
problemsNote_one: The version description has {{count}} issue. The form will not add new ones; existing ones are in the checks findings.
problemsNote_other: The version description has {{count}} issues. The form will not add new ones; existing ones are in the checks findings.

idProblem.format: Latin letters, digits and “_” only; starts with a letter

idHint.key: Latin letters, digits and “_”. Templates print the field as project.meta.<name>. Built from the name; change it only if needed.
idHint.id: Latin letters, digits, “_” and a single “-”. Built from the name; change it only if needed.

groups.title: Field groups
groups.lead: The order of groups is the order in the project settings.
groups.empty: No groups: fields come as one list.
groups.inUse: The group has fields: move them first
groups.label: Group label
groups.sectionHint: Where the group shows in the project settings.

fields.title: Project fields
fields.lead: What a student fills in the project wizard and settings. On the right: a sample of the field and the documents that print it.
fields.scopeHint: In a team project each author has their own author field.
fields.label: Label
fields.autoHint: Filled in on creation if the field is empty.
fields.autoAcademicYear: End year of the academic year
fields.kindsHint: Both checked: the field is in every kind of work.
fields.renamePerson: A project person lives in its own field: the short name stays
fields.samplePerson: The person is chosen on the supervisors step: name, position, HSE or company.
fields.unused: The field is not printed anywhere. Check that it is needed.
fields.unusedRequired: The field is required on creation but is not printed anywhere.
fields.renameTitle: New short name for the field {{key}}
fields.renameLead: The name changes in the version description and in every template (project.meta.<name>). For projects on older versions this removes one field and adds another:
fields.deleteLead: The field leaves the version description. Templates that print it stay as they are.
fields.deletePrinted: The field prints in: {{docs}}. After deletion it will be empty there.

forms.title: Forms
forms.lead: Forms a student fills in the project, such as the AI usage declaration.
forms.requiredForPackHint: An unfilled form gives a warning when the pack is built.
forms.perAuthorHint: In a team project every author fills the form.
forms.outputTemplateHint: Path of the file in the version, for example files/ai-usage/form.md.
forms.fieldId: Short name of the form field
forms.widgetHint: radio and chips for lists, slider for a number.
forms.visibleIfHint: The field shows only if another field of the form has the value.

readOnly: This version is released: its files are read-only. Edits go into a new template version.

documents.title: Version documents
documents.lead: The order of documents here is the order in a project. A group draws a subheading in the document list.
documents.sourceHint: A blank document or a copy of a document from the packs of this workspace (latest template version).
documents.groupHint: The list section the document sits in. Without a group the document goes to “Other”.
documents.removeLead: The document goes away and its folder with all files is deleted. For projects this removes a document: the new version needs at least new features.
documents.referenced: The version description mentions the document. After deletion fix these places, the check findings will show them:

tech.idHint: The document folder in the version (files/<name>/). Latin letters, digits, “_” and a single “-”. Built from the name.

languages.title: Version languages
languages.lead: The languages the version's documents come in. The first language is the main one: translations start from it and it is used when a translation is missing.
languages.undeclared: The version description sets no languages: the version is in Russian. An added language is written explicitly.
languages.lastOne: At least one language is needed
languages.inUse: Files exist in this language: remove them first
languages.filesLead: A file without a language serves all languages. “Create translation” copies the file in the main language; translate the text in the editor.
languages.mixed: The file exists both shared and per language: the check treats this as an error
languages.splitHint: The file becomes the “{{lang}}” edition and gets a copy to translate
languages.translateHint: A copy of the “{{from}}” edition for every file without a “{{lang}}” translation
languages.translateNone: Every file with editions already has a “{{lang}}” translation
languages.noSources: The document folder has no text files.

doc.title: Document terms
doc.lead: Which kinds of work need the document, which languages it comes in and how the finished file is named.
doc.notInRoster: This document is not in the version's document list: no form, edit the file text.
doc.name: Name
doc.gostRefHint: Which set of rules checks this document.
doc.scopeHint: In a team project each author has their own personal document.
doc.requiredHint: Without it the project is not ready for submission.
doc.langsHint: Empty: the document exists in every version language.
doc.variantsLead: Other formats of the same document: PowerPoint, HTML, Beamer.
doc.variantLangsHint: Empty: the variant exists in every language.

tech.folderHint: The folder name changes only in the document list.
tech.engineHint: none: the variant is not built with TeX.
